Hi Emily —

Great to meet you at the summit last week. Per our discussion, we can put a Private Offer on GCP Marketplace for Cobalt Systems. To keep your finance and engineering teams aligned I wanted to propose a consumption/drawdown cadence that matches how you plan to ramp product usage.

Quick asks:
- Could you confirm the preferred invoice cadence (monthly vs. quarterly)?
- Do you need any front-loading for initial onboarding credits?
- Any contract or PO timelines we should be aware of?

Proposed approach (high-level):
- Commit: $240k over 12 months
- Suggested drawdown: monthly buckets with a 30% uptick allowed in months 1–2 for onboarding
- Billing: monthly invoices tied to consumption buckets, with an escrow-style reconciliation at quarter end

If that sounds reasonable, can we set a 30-minute call next week to lock the schedule and hand this to billing/legal? I cc'ed Priya to coordinate the internal handoffs.

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Ben —

Thanks for the note and the clear proposal. A few immediate items from procurement: 

1) Invoice cadence: Cobalt prefers net-30 monthly invoices. We need invoice dates to align to the first of the month where possible.
2) Consumption vs committed drawdown: Procurement needs a firm schedule we can include on the PO (monthly committed amounts + overage rules).
3) Compliance ask: Can you confirm whether Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and a standard data processing addendum (DPA)?
4) Procurement timeline: We typically need a signed PO within 10 business days of term confirmation.

Can your legal/billing team share a sample term sheet and proposed drawdown table? If you can send that over, I’ll route to our finance team and circle back with any redlines.

Priya —

Draft attached below (inline) for the monthly committed drawdown and billing waterfall. I pulled conservative buckets given Cobalt's initial ramp comment. Happy to iterate but this should be PO-ready.

Draft monthly committed drawdown (12-month commit = $240k):
- Month 1: $30,000 (includes onboarding buffer)
- Month 2: $28,000
- Month 3: $20,000
- Month 4: $18,000
- Month 5: $18,000
- Month 6: $18,000
- Month 7: $16,000
- Month 8: $14,000
- Month 9: $12,000
- Month 10: $12,000
- Month 11: $8,000
- Month 12: $6,000

Billing waterfall / invoice rules:
- Monthly net-30 invoices generated on the 1st of the month for prior month committed bucket + measured overage (if any).
- Overage charged at standard list rate; client billed monthly with line items for committed bucket vs overage.
- Quarterly reconciliation: any under-utilized committed amounts will be credited in the first invoice of the following quarter or applied to future usage per PO terms.
- Front-loading: allow up to +30% consumption in months 1–2 with explicit onboarding credit applied to month 3 reconciliation.

Compliance note: SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA; we surface DPA standard clauses in Marketplace terms. Marissa — please provide the exact DPA link/text we should embed.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bCobalt-Offer-Resources
